body.title: Implement the live qualification suite
body.summary: Implement a standalone function that runs the bounded-retry allow-side probe (insrc_analyze / insrc_analyze_step reachable and completing), the immediate-fail deny/bypass probes using structural catalog evidence with the reconciled pass/fail polarity (a REQUIRED tool's exclusion/denial fails qualification; a DISALLOWED tool's exclusion/denial passes it; an actual bypass-absence failure -- a disallowed tool completing -- fails immediately, never retried), and export.json fingerprint extraction (readExitEvidence, reused in-module) with fail-closed behavior on a missing/unparsable export. Concurrent qualification requests for the same stable descriptor are coalesced into one in-flight probe run.
acceptanceChecks: The allow-side probe retries a bounded number of times on simulated connector-not-registered failures, then reports 'unavailable' with the reason if still unresolved
A structural catalog exclusion/denial of a disallowed tool PASSES qualification; exclusion/denial of a REQUIRED tool FAILS it
A genuine bypass-absence failure (a disallowed tool actually completes) fails qualification immediately with no retry
A missing or unparsable export.json fails qualification closed, never silently treated as passing
effectiveConfigFingerprint is extracted from a successful qualification probe's own export.json
Two concurrent calls that miss the cache for the identical stable descriptor share one in-flight qualification promise rather than running the probe suite twice

the blanket-bypass absence proof via catalog enumeration
the ac4 no-mutation proof via structural catalog evidence that write/bash tools are absent or denied, never via an actual write under the production profile
the export.json effective-config fingerprint actually present and parsable on a real run
